+    ["undefined arg", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger(undefined)`, true],
+    ["null arg", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger(null)`, true],
+    ["no logPath prop", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ level: "info" })`, true],
+    ["logPath undefined", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ logPath: undefined })`, true],
+    ["logPath null", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ logPath: null })`, true],
+    ["relative literal", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ logPath: "logs/app.log" })`, true],
+    ["spread + relative", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ ...base, logPath: "logs/app.log" })`, true],
+    ["absolute literal /", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ logPath: "/var/log/app.log" })`, false],
+    ["absolute UNC", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ logPath: "\\\\\\\\server\\\\share" })`, false],
+    ["only spreads", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ ...opts })`, false],
+    ["non-literal logPath", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nimport path from "path"\nconst l = new FileLogger({ logPath: path.resolve("x") })`, false],
+    ["dynamic var arg", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger(myOpts)`, false],
+    ["aliased ESM", `import { FileLogger as FL } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FL()`, true],
+    ["namespace ESM", `import * as typeorm from "typeorm"\nconst l = new typeorm.FileLogger()`, true],
+    ["cjs destructured", `const { FileLogger } = require("typeorm")\nconst l = new FileLogger()`, true],
+    ["cjs aliased", `const { FileLogger: FL } = require("typeorm")\nconst l = new FL()`, true],
+    ["cjs whole module", `const typeorm = require("typeorm")\nconst l = new typeorm.FileLogger()`, true],
+    ["other package", `import { FileLogger } from "other-pkg"\nconst l = new FileLogger()`, false],
+    ["return stmt", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nfunction f() { return new FileLogger() }`, true],
+    ["export default", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nexport default new FileLogger()`, true],
